UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User preferences for Jani AI voice output and multilingual settings.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this profile.

autoSpeak.description: Whether Jani automatically speaks responses aloud.

speechRate.description: TTS playback speed multiplier between 0.5 and 2.0.

MemoryEntry.title: MemoryEntry
MemoryEntry.description: Permanent user memory saved manually or auto-extracted by Jani AI.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this memory.

title.description: Short summary title for the memory.

content.description: Full memory content remembered across sessions.

source.description: Whether created manually or extracted automatically during chat.

pinned.description: Whether this memory is pinned to the top of Jani's active context.

ChatMessageEntry.title: ChatMessageEntry
ChatMessageEntry.description: Persistent conversation message between the user and Jani AI.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this conversation.

text.description: Message body text in Urdu, Hindi, or English.

commandAction.description: Optional verified command action label attached to the turn.

/users/{userId}/memories/{memoryId}.description: Permanent memories scoped to the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Persistent conversation history scoped to the authenticated user.
